exposure: Treatment group (UAE + D&C vs. methotrexate + D&C)
Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with dilation and curettage (D&C)
outcome: Time to resolution of β-human chorionic gonadotropin level
finding: UAE combined with D&C within 24 hours was associated with less blood loss, shorter hospital stay, and fewer additional interventions compared to methotrexate followed by D&C for the treatment of CSP.
